title: Magellan radar finds metallic snow on Venus

tellings.quote: in fact, I was at NASA when the Mellan probe was mapping Venus using radar.

plain: In the 1990s, NASA's Magellan probe mapped the surface of Venus by radar and, as the story goes, picked up what looked like metallic snow on the planet's mountains. A physicist named Kevin Knuth tells it as a former NASA scientist who was there, saying "I was at NASA when the Magellan probe was mapping Venus using radar."
